=# V. How to contribute=

Examples:

* Helps to improve the wiki page.
* Makes screenshots or videos to promote the project.
* Helps maintaining the infrastructure of the project (source repository, build process, YAS server, issue tracker).
* Supports the project with infrastructure.

Basically any help besides play-testing and development.

Check [[OAC:Project#Project_team|contact]] if you feel like contributing!
